reviews.author: Jeevan
reviews.text:
It is very hard to find a doctor who comes across as honest and patient in these dark times for the medical industry. Dr. Akshay is a rare gem in this muddy medical field which is plaguing Andhra Pradesh.

We visited Dr. Akshay on two separate occasions, one was for my wife's foot blister problem. This problem was explained and provided options for, eventually it was suppressed and we are happy that all it took was five tablets and moisturiser. We then went to visit again for my father for a skin condition and we were advised promptly on possible solutions.

The OP fee is Rs. 300 which I find very reasonable for his expert views on issues. I was due to visit tp plan for my hair issues but did not have the time to as I had to travel. Next time I arrive, we will certainly visit Dr. Akshay.

On both the occasions, we visited at 6pm and had minimal waiting time. We are pleased to have come across Dr. Akshay on Google Maps and his clinic is only 600 meters from my place.

For anyone with skin conditions in Guntur or around Guntur, please do visit Dr. Akshay Jain. It is not normal for me to recommend someone so strongly but it is your loss if you go to any other dermatologist.

Keep up the good work doctor, see you soon.
